test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The government is said to have downplayed the findings deliberately.

options.text: The findings are said to be downplayed by the government.
It is said that the findings were downplayed deliberately.
The findings are said to have been downplayed deliberately by the government.
Deliberate findings were said to be downplayed by the government.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure for infinitives: When dealing with a perfect infinitive ("to have + past participle"), the passive form becomes "to have been + past participle".
 
• In the given sentence, the active action is inside the infinitive phrase: "to have downplayed the findings."
 
• To convert this to the passive voice, the object of the infinitive ("the findings") is moved to become the main subject of the sentence.
 
• The reporting verb must agree with the new plural subject, so "is said" changes to "are said".
 
• Change the active perfect infinitive "to have downplayed" to its passive form: "to have been downplayed".
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original logical subject "the government."
 
• Ensure the adverb "deliberately" remains to accurately reflect the original meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The findings are said to have been downplayed deliberately by the government."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The findings are said to be downplayed by the government." – Incorrect tense. It uses the simple passive infinitive ("to be downplayed") instead of the perfect passive infinitive, which loses the past action context.
 
• **Option 2: **"It is said that the findings were downplayed deliberately." – Incorrect because it completely changes the sentence structure and omits the crucial agent ("by the government").
 
• **Option 4: **"Deliberate findings were said to be downplayed by the government." – Incorrect. This alters the meaning of the sentence by changing the adverb "deliberately" into an adjective modifying "findings."
